network_status.network: IdeAmbiente - alluvione in Sardegna del dicembre 2004
network_status.summary_it: La fonte ISPRA colloca il ponte crollato sulla SS129 al bivio per Galtelli, mentre il record lo attribuisce al Taloro presso Nuoro. Il rapporto descrive nello stesso evento le piene di Cedrino e Posada ma non conferma il Taloro: nessuna misura puo essere trasferita finche l'attraversamento non e riallineato.
network_status.summary_en: The ISPRA source locates the collapsed SS129 bridge at the Galtelli junction, while the record assigns it to the Taloro near Nuoro. The report describes Cedrino and Posada flooding in the same event but does not confirm the Taloro, so no measurement can be transferred until the crossing is reconciled.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
